properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Bastion: Audit Diagnostic Settings Enabled
properties.description: Audits that Azure Bastion hosts have diagnostic settings configured to forward audit logs to a Log Analytics workspace. FedRAMP High requires audit generation (AU-12) for all privileged access events. Bastion audit logs capture session start/stop, user identity, target VM, and connection details required for privileged access monitoring.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists: Report non-compliance when diagnostic settings are not configured on Bastion host. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
